features.title: Relationship tier readout
features.adaptation: Derive Wary/Acquainted/Confidant from existing authoritative trust with no second mutable relationship score.
features.acceptance: Thresholds are deterministic and reads do not mutate dialogue state.

features.title: Per-topic substantive dialogue checkpoints
features.adaptation: Retain the latest accepted substantive beat per existing topic with a sequence witness; previews/redundant beats do not replace it.
features.acceptance: Checkpoint is stable across preview/repeat/close beats and invalid IDs fail closed.

features.title: Idempotent ending archive
features.adaptation: Remember only authoritative committed AidCivilians/PursueRift outcomes, without copying comparator rewards or stories.
features.acceptance: Duplicate, None, or mismatched commits cannot inflate ending count.

features.title: Evidence-gated story episodes
features.adaptation: Original MallWitness/RiftConfidant/CryptPartner episodes derive from existing lore, clues, trust and outcome evidence.
features.acceptance: Episodes unlock monotonically only from existing authoritative evidence; invalid episode IDs fail closed.

features.title: Non-mutating checkpoint revisit
features.adaptation: Expose a saved branch beat for review without calling Choose or mutating story state.

features.title: Interruption-safe latest dialogue recovery
features.adaptation: Capture the latest accepted beat once and acknowledge it exactly once, without re-running dialogue mutation.
features.acceptance: Pending recovery cannot be overwritten, no-beat capture fails, acknowledge clears exactly once, and no story mutation is replayed.
